jobs.occupation: Talencia Consulting - Data Scientist / Data Engineer - Medior
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Medior Data Engineer / Data Scientist to join an Advanced Analytics team and contribute to a wide range of data-driven and AI initiatives.

The role combines data science, Machine Learning, advanced analytics and generative AI, with projects covering various business areas such as Marketing, e-Commerce, Product, Customer Excellence, Stores, Supply Chain and Procurement.

You will work closely with data, technology and business teams to transform complex datasets into actionable insights and develop innovative AI-driven solutions.
Responsibilities

• Data analysis & Machine Learning:

• Analyze large and complex datasets using advanced statistical and Machine Learning techniques.

• Identify trends, patterns and opportunities to support data-driven business decisions.

• Develop, deploy and optimize Machine Learning models.

• Work on Generative AI and Agentic AI use cases, including AI agents.

• Continuously evaluate and fine-tune models to improve their performance and business value.

• MLOps:

• Apply MLOps best practices throughout the Machine Learning lifecycle.

• Implement model versioning, continuous integration and automated deployment processes.

• Monitor model performance and ensure the reliability of production models.

• Contribute to model retraining, maintenance and continuous improvement.

• Collaboration:

• Work closely with Data Platform, Data Insights and Business teams to understand requirements and deliver appropriate solutions.

• Translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.

• Present complex technical findings and analytical results clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Contribute to Agile squads and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Innovation & AI:

• Stay up to date with the latest developments in Data Science, Machine Learning and Generative AI.

• Investigate and experiment with emerging AI technologies.

• Explore Agentic AI and AI-agent architectures to identify new opportunities and improve data capabilities.

• Contribute to the adoption of innovative data and AI solutions within the organization.

• 
Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics or another relevant scientific/business-oriented field.

• 
3+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist, Data Engineer or in a closely related role.

• 
Strong experience applying advanced statistics and Machine Learning to real-world business problems.

• 
Ability to transform complex data into clear, actionable business insights.

• 
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.

• 
Experience working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly technologies such as:

• 
Vertex AI

• 
BigQuery

• 
Dataform

• 
Understanding of MLOps principles and practices.

• 
Experience working in Agile environments, such as Scrum or Kanban.

• 
Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects from concept through implementation.

• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to interact with both technical and business stakeholders.

• 
Fluent in english and proficient in french or dutch.

Nice to have:

• 
Experience with Generative AI.

• 
Experience with Agentic AI / AI Agents.

• 
Experience with GCP agentic AI technologies such as ADK or Model Armor.

• 
Previous experience in the Retail sector.

• 
Experience working on large-scale data or AI transformation projects.

Candidate profile

We are looking for a hands-on Medior Data Scientist / Data Engineer who combines strong technical skills with a solid understanding of business needs.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working with Python, SQL, GCP, Machine Learning and MLOps, while also being able to communicate effectively with business stakeholders. A genuine interest in Generative AI and Agentic AI is highly valued.

The ability to work independently, take initiative and collaborate within multidisciplinary Agile teams will be key to succeeding in this role.

In case of interest in this job, please send us immediately your updated resume.

jobs.occupation: Atcon Global - Senior Data Platform Engineer (Spark / Spark Connect)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer / Spark Engineer to join a major Asset Management transformation program and help build a new enterprise data platform following the integration with AXA Investment Managers.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with deep expertise in Apache Spark and Spark Connect, and experience building high-performance, large-scale data platforms in modern cloud-native environments.
What you'll do

• Design, develop, and optimize scalable data platform components using Spark and Spark Connect

• Build high-performance solutions for large-scale distributed data processing

• Contribute to the architecture and development of a new enterprise data platform

• Deploy and operate Spark workloads in Kubernetes environments

• Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and platform teams across the organization

What we're looking for

• Senior-level Apache Spark experience (must)

• Strong Spark Connect experience (must)

• Solid software/data engineering background

• Experience with large-scale or distributed data platforms

• Kubernetes experience is highly desirable

• Fluent English; French is an advantage

Why join?

You'll be part of a strategic data platform initiative within a leading Asset Management environment, working on modern data infrastructure and scalable engineering solutions with a strong focus on innovation and long-term impact.

If you have hands-on experience with Spark and Spark Connect and enjoy building robust data platforms, we'd love to hear from you.
-

Platform Engineer - AI & Agentic Platform (Azure)

Important Info

📍 Braine-l'Alleud, Belgium - Hybrid

📅 Start: ASAP

📆 Contract: Initial 6 months, with possible extension

🏠 Onsite: Approx. 2 days/week

🌍 Language: English mandatory; French/Dutch is a plus

Context

We are looking for a Platform Engineer to help shape and evolve an enterprise AI platform built on Azure AI Foundry and related Azure services.

This is a hands-on role combining Platform Engineering, Cloud, DevOps and Solution Architecture, with strong collaboration across Security, Integration and Enterprise Architecture teams.

Responsibilities

• Own and coordinate the technical architecture of the AI platform.

• Translate platform needs into scalable technical solutions.

• Explore new Azure AI capabilities and build PoCs/prototypes.

• Define architecture, integration patterns, networking and technical decisions.

• Coordinate implementation across Cloud, Security, DevOps and Integration teams.

• Support CI/CD, automation, developer tooling and platform improvements.

• Manage the technical backlog and help remove cross-team blockers.

Requirements

• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure.

• Solid background in Cloud, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure or DevOps.

• Good knowledge of Azure networking, Entra ID and Identity & Access Management.

• Experience with Terraform and/or Bicep.

• CI/CD experience with Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions.

• Understanding of API Management, enterprise cloud environments and DevOps practices.

• Scripting experience with Python, Bash or PowerShell.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.

• Proactive, autonomous and comfortable working across multiple technical teams.

Nice to Have

• Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Search

• Azure API Management

• Databricks or Boomi

• AI/LLM platform experience

• Architecture Decision Records or Enterprise Architecture exposure

• AWS/GCP background with the ability to transition quickly to Azure

Experience: Typically 5+ years, though strong candidates with 3-5 years of relevant cloud/infrastructure experience may also be considered.
-

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Energy & Utilities Project / Program Manager
jobs.description:
Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

Inetum Consulting is a strategy and transformation consulting firm part of the Inetum group. With a team of 450 multidisciplinary consultants, we are present in Europe (France, Spain, Portugal, Belgium) and Africa (Morocco).

Inetum Consulting supports companies and public organizations in their strategic projects through five major offerings: CIO Advisory, Sustainability, Data & GenAI, Transformation & Change, Corporate Functions Advisory.

Guided by a sector-specific consulting approach enriched by innovation and technological solutions, we help our customers steer their transformation towards sustainable performance and a more resilient, responsible society.

We value a unique and strong corporate culture, imbued with the values of excellence, which contributes significantly to the success of organizations.

At inetum consulting, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. we strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

We are looking for a bright and enthusiastic Project Manager / Program Manager for our Energy & Utilities Consulting team, committed to building relationships and delivering results. We are interested in people with proven track records in delivering mid-large scale digital projects. We believe in people we hire, we encourage people to take ownership by given them the right support, environment and tools to be successful at Inetum. You will get the opportunity to contribute actively within the Energy & Utilities ecosystem to support the growth of the team, expand our offering and participate to seminars, publications,....

Your responsibilities

 
• Leading the initiation, definition and implementation of the program at one of our customers in the Energy & Utilities sector
 
• Building a program roadmap and ensuring the realization
 
• Managing a team of experienced project managers
 
• Follow-up of the realization of the program objectives and assuring it remains in line with the clients strategy
 
• Reporting on the progress of the realization of the program objectives to the business management
 
• Follow-up of the program KPI's and budget
 
• Management of the program risks
 
• Assuring the proper functioning of the core team
 
• As your assignments evolve, you will gradually take on project lead roles and actively contribute to the growth of our consulting unit through knowledge sharing, offer development, and participation...
...

•  Master's degree (engineering or business school)

• +5 years' experience in managing complex programs

• Energy & Utilities sector experience

• Experience in Asset Management and GIS is a plus

• Proven experience in one or more project management methodologies. (Prince2, PMBOK, etc.)

• Strong leadership skills

• Being able to bring structure, being able to keep calm

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to manage project teams and engage senior client stakeholders

• Entrepreneurial mindset and motivation to collaborate and grow within the Inetum Consulting business line

• Fluent in English and fluent in either Dutch or French (with professional working proficiency in the other language being a strong asset)

jobs.occupation: Atcon Global - AI Architect (Microsoft Copilot Studio)
jobs.description:
Location: Leuven, Belgium (50% onsite)

Contract: ASAP - April 2027

Languages: Dutch and English required
About the role

We are looking for a Senior AI Architect to join the GenAI Enablement Team and strengthen the Software Factory responsible for enabling and governing conversational AI solutions across the organization.

This role combines strategic architecture, platform governance, and hands-on implementation. In addition to supporting ongoing initiatives, you will help define the future direction of the Microsoft Copilot Studio platform and ecosystem.
Key responsibilities

• Act as a subject matter expert for Microsoft Copilot Studio and related Power Platform technologies

• Help define the roadmap and strategic vision for the evolution of the Copilot Studio Software Factory

• Evaluate architectural patterns, governance models, platform capabilities, and best practices

• Advise on scalability, maintainability, security, and operational excellence of conversational AI solutions

• Support the design and implementation of complex Copilot Studio solutions

• Guide teams on SDLC, DevOps, CI/CD, testing, and release management practices

• Collaborate with architects to translate strategic concepts into implementable solutions

• Stay up to date with Copilot Studio product releases and platform enhancements

• Assess new platform features and identify opportunities for adoption

• Coach and mentor internal team members on Copilot Studio and Power Platform best practices

• Contribute to documentation, standards, and reusable implementation patterns

• 2+ years of enterprise experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio

• Strong knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem

• Proven experience designing and implementing conversational AI solutions

• Experience defining platform strategy, governance, and architectural guidelines

• Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) principles

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

• Experience with GitHub and source control best practices

• Strong Azure knowledge, including authentication, integrations, monitoring, and cloud-native services

• Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and cloud automation

• Experience working in complex enterprise environments with multiple stakeholders and governance requirements

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Profile

• Strategic thinker with a pragmatic mindset

• Comfortable challenging existing approaches constructively

• Able to work under high-pressure scenarios

• Capable of motivating, mentoring, and steering teams through change and complexity while maintaining delivery focus

• Strong facilitator and communicator

• Comfortable operating at both strategic and implementation level

• Self-starter who can work independently while collaborating effectively with architects, engineers, and business stakeholders

For a Non-Profit Client of mine based in Brussels, I am actively searching for a Data Modeler/Architect to provide their expertise on a project.

The organisation is a non-profit managing programmes across multiple countries. They're moving away from separate data models and systems across programmes towards a common data model and governance framework, with a data lakehouse also being developed for reporting.

• 6 years+ of relevant experience

• Strong Data Modeling/Architecture experience

• Prior experience in guiding organizations through modernization of DB environment

• SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar platforms

• Strong stakeholder management skills

• English speaking

• Able to work hybrid in Brussels

 

Are you interested? Please send your CV.

Location : Herstal (Liège)

Start date : ASAP

Duration : Full-time Open-Ended Contract (CDI)
Context 

For one ou my close partner, I'm currently recruiting for a Business Intelligence Manager position within a large Belgian organisation undergoing an important Data & BI transformation.

The role combines people management, BI strategy and hands-on involvement in the evolution of the organisation's Data & BI landscape
Description

• Lead and develop a team of BI professionals (circ. 5 people)

• Define and implement the BI roadmap and strategy

• Contribute to Data Governance, Data Quality and Data Management

• You will be directly reporting the the current Head of Data

What's in for you

• Between 5.000EUR and 8.000EUR GR./mo (with at least an extra 150EUR of NET allowance)

• Company car (electric) with charging card

• Health and group insurance

• Up to 30 days of paid holidays

• Hybrid work model with 3 days remote

• Various bonuses and sectorial benefits

 

The position offers the opportunity to have a significant strategic impact on the organisation's Data & BI landscape, while managing a dedicated team.

In case of interest in this job, please send us your updated resume.

• 7+ years of experience in Business Intelligence / Data

• Strong knowledge of Power BI, SAP BusinessObjects and SQL

• Good understanding of Data Warehousing / Data Architecture

• Experience with Data Governance and Data Quality

• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication and change management skills

• Fluent in Dutch and/or French, with good knowledge of English

• Business administration tools (pricing, contracts management, billing...)

• Electronic document management solutions (medical prescription, notarial deeds...)

• Intelligent apps...

Your tasks

• Provide technical analysis based on business requirements

• Take part in workload estimation

• Development of front end and/or back end applications

• Implement the developed solution

• Follow up on software lifecycle management: Continuous integration, release management, Unit testing, documentation, ...

• Keep up to date with new technologies and challenge yourself with experts

• Extensive experience in Java JEE development with frameworks/tools like Spring, Maven, Eclipse, Hibernate, NetBeans...

• You love to think about the business benefits of your developments

• You enjoy to write performing code and have a natural orientation toward quality

• You love to propose improvements to the rest of the team

• You love to challenge your ideas

• You master French or Dutch & English

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 27.000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

Do you thrive at the heart of an organisation, where everything comes together? Are you energized by connecting people, driving performance, and creating impact? Then Inetum might be exactly what you're looking for.

As a Service Delivery Manager, you are the key link between our customers and our organization. You take ownership of the daily governance of large and complex IT outsourcing agreements and ensure everything runs smoothly—both operationally and strategically.

You don't just manage services—you elevate them. By building strong relationships and spotting opportunities, you help customers grow while continuously improving our internal ways of working. In short, you become a trusted advisor who truly makes a difference.

What you'll do

 
• Drive strong SLA and KPI performance by working closely with Operations teams and translating data into actionable insights
 
• Build lasting customer relationships through regular reviews, performance discussions, and forward-looking ideas
 
• Take ownership of financials: monitor budgets, safeguard margins, and ensure accurate invoicing
 
• Act as a connector between Sales, Solution Architects, and Project Managers to bring new ideas to life
 
• Proactively identify opportunities—for your customer and for Inetum—and lead them from idea to implementation

Additional information

 
• A high-impact role where you take ownership of complex infrastructure projects that shape customer success and business outcomes.
 
• A workplace that invests in you, offering training opportunities, certifications, and support to further develop your project management and technical skills.
 
• The chance to coach and mentor junior project managers, helping them grow while strengthening your own leadership capabilities.
 
• Variety in your work: you'll collaborate with different customers across diverse industries and environments, giving you broad exposure and constant learning opportunities.
 
• Autonomy and trust to drive decisions, manage your team, and shape project execution in a way that aligns with your expertise.
 
• Collaboration with strong technical teams — engineers, analysts, architects — giving you a chance to deepen your understanding of ICT infrastructure and operational practices.
 
• Career growth paths, whether toward senior project leadership, program management, or specialized technology domains.
 
• A supportive PM community, encouraging knowledge sharing, best practices, and continuous improvement.
 
• A culture that values...
...

• You're a natural communicator who easily connects with people at all levels and across cultures. Switching between Dutch, English, and French feels effortless

• You're confident in challenging the status quo, influencing stakeholders, and bringing people along in your vision

• You combine sharp organizational skills with a hands-on, can-do mindset. Deadlines motivate you, and you know how to prioritize what really matters

• You enjoy working autonomously, take ownership, and are comfortable making decisions

• You think at master's level, have a solid grasp of MS Office, and quickly adapt to new tools and technologies

• An ITIL certification or Service Manager is a plus, but your passion for the ICT sector is what truly sets you apart

Introduction
 

Our truck factory in Ghent is the largest Volvo Group truck factory worldwide. Every day, almost 3000 colleagues assemble top-quality trucks here. Innovation and continuous improvement are standard on our agenda, and that from day 1. We therefore firmly believe in the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing, in which attention to quality, safety and the environment are our top priority. Our site today has many different departments, but we all have one thing in common: passion for what we do. 
 

Meet your team
 

You will join a team of engineers who work both independently and in a team. Together we support each other to give the customer a qualitative and feasible solution to meet the desired truck specifications.
 

Your ideal job?
 

On our assembly line and in the Market Adaptation Center, all requests for a customized truck are handled according to the following principle: Our customer? He is king. Do you have good technical insight and would you like to take on the challenge with us to support the customer in the design of the ideal truck?
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• Investigate and answer customer questions about technical concepts that are not offered as a standard. This in terms of technical feasibility, cost price, lead time & legal compliance.  

• Advising other departments on technical product solutions to adapt standard trucks to customer demand. In doing so, you make decisions independently and take final responsibility for these concepts. 

• You ensure optimal coordination and cooperation between various parties involved (design, order planning, suppliers, sales engineers) so that the production of the designs is ensured efficiently and on time. 

• Continuously polish your technical knowledge & keep your product knowledge up-to-date 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field. Additional knowledge in economics can be an added value. Technical knowledge related to vehicles and/or knowledge of the automotive industry is an advantage. 

• Being able to work in a team is a must. You easily make contacts and maintain good relationships with others. 

• Be administrative, organizational, and commercially skilled. 

• Have excellent networking skills. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office. 

• Good knowledge of English is a requirement (other languages are an advantage).

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business  

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Czech and Polish.
